label: Town of Clarendon
header:
# Town of Clarendon municipal roster backfill -- Vermont
# municipal fan-out batch 6; issue #163 (VT master tracking).

sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Selectboard Members' directory (updated June 5, 2026): lists five Clarendon Selectboard members: George Ambrose, Robert Congdon, Michael Klopchin, Don Pratt, and Cash Ruane.

Town of Clarendon official website, Town Minutes & Agenda archive: Selectboard minutes, September-October 2026, seat the same five, with Mike Klopchin as Chair; the March 2026 annual-meeting returns re-elected Klopchin (475 votes, 3-year term) and Ruane (472 votes, 2-year term).

Town of Clarendon official website (clarendonvt.gov): the town's contacts page styles the office 'Town Clerk/Administrator' and names Kimberly Young as the appointed Town Clerk/Administrator; she signs the town's 2026 minutes as Town Clerk. The holder is recorded as appointed. The Secretary of State Guide (January 2026) still names Gloria Menard, who appears on the town's current contacts page as Assistant Town Clerk -- a 2026 succession; the town's current page governs.

Town of Clarendon official website (clarendonvt.gov): the March 2026 annual-meeting returns re-elected Heidi Congdon as Town Treasurer (505 votes, 1-year term); Selectboard minutes, September 2026, list her as Treasurer.
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, & County Clerks' (January 2026): lists Heidi Congdon as Town Treasurer of Clarendon.
Town of Clarendon official website (clarendonvt.gov): the March 2026 annual-meeting returns elected Heidi Congdon as Collector of Delinquent Taxes as a separate office (507 votes, 1-year term).

Town of Clarendon official website (clarendonvt.gov): the March 2026 annual-meeting returns elected David A. Potter Jr. as Moderator (elected annually; recorded as the 2026 write-in winner with 2 votes).

Town of Clarendon official website (clarendonvt.gov): the town's lister records and the 2025 Annual Report officers table list three Lister seats: Danielle Jewell (term expiring 2027) and David Kelly (term expiring 2028) are seated; the third seat (Patricia Kent, term expiring 2026) stood for election in 2026 and no official source publishes its outcome, so it is left unfilled.
Town of Clarendon official website (clarendonvt.gov): the March 2026 annual-meeting returns elected Edward Babic as Constable (505 votes, 1-year term); Clarendon elects a single constable.

Town of Clarendon official website (clarendonvt.gov): the Bailey Memorial Library trustee roster lists five seats on 5-year staggered terms: Carol Stewart (term expiring 2030), Jan Baker (2029), and Tina Sherman (2028) are seated; one seat is printed as vacant (2027) and the seat expiring in 2026 has no published outcome, so both are left unfilled.

Town of Clarendon official website (clarendonvt.gov): the town's cemetery records list three Cemetery Commissioner seats: Ashley Page (term expiring 2027) and Joseph Carrara (2028) are seated; the third seat stood in 2026 and is vacant, so it is left unfilled.

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, '2025-2026 Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): lists eight Clarendon justices of the peace: George Ambrose, David Bosch, Robert Congdon, John Colvin, Deborah Dougherty, Kevin Dougherty, Arthur Menard, and Brownson Spencer.

jp_election.name: Town of Clarendon Justice of the Peace Election 2024-11-05

sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, '2025-2026 Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): lists eight Clarendon justices of the peace elected November 5, 2024: George Ambrose, David Bosch, Robert Congdon, John Colvin, Deborah Dougherty, Kevin Dougherty, Arthur Menard, and Brownson Spencer. The listing publishes no vote totals or party labels and none are recorded.
